user.title: Configure Atomberg Lock
user.description: Enter your device parameters below (sample placeholders provided).

error.cannot_connect: Could not establish BLE connection to the lock. Ensure it is awake and within range.
error.invalid_master_key: STATIC_MASTER_KEY must be exactly 16 characters (ASCII) or 32 hex characters.
error.invalid_lock_salt: LOCK_SALT must be exactly 4 bytes in hex format (8 hex characters, e.g. 1a2b3c4d).
error.auth_failed: Authentication failed (F0/F1/F2). Verify your STATIC_MASTER_KEY and LOCK_SALT, and ensure the official mobile app is completely closed.

connection.title: Atomberg Lock Settings
connection.description: View or update the configured BLE parameters.

init.title: Atomberg Lock
init.description: Manage OTP codes or update the Bluetooth connection. Close the Atomberg phone app before using the lock here.

otp_read.title: Read OTP pool
otp_read.description: The pool could not be read. Select Submit to return to the menu.

otp_refill.title: Refill OTPs
otp_refill.description: Write new random six-digit codes to the lock. Start with one code for testing. Codes are shown after acknowledgement and read-back. This does not synchronize the Atomberg app.

otp_result.title: OTP results
otp_result.description:
**{operation}**

Codes returned: **{count}**

{codes}

Keep these codes private. They are not saved in sensor history. Reading does not reserve or consume a code; expiry and remaining uses are not known. Copy any codes you need, then select Submit to return to the menu.

otp_refill_failed.title: Refill could not be verified
otp_refill_failed.description: Some codes may already have been written. Select Submit to return to the menu, then read the OTP pool before starting another refill.

error.cannot_connect: Could not establish BLE connection to the lock. Ensure it is awake and within range.
error.invalid_master_key: STATIC_MASTER_KEY must be exactly 16 characters (ASCII) or 32 hex characters.
error.invalid_lock_salt: LOCK_SALT must be exactly 4 bytes in hex format (8 hex characters, e.g. 1a2b3c4d).
error.auth_failed: Authentication failed (F0/F1/F2). Verify your STATIC_MASTER_KEY and LOCK_SALT, and ensure the official mobile app is completely closed.
error.lock_not_loaded: The lock integration is not loaded. Reload it and try again.
error.otp_read_failed: Could not read the pool. Close the Atomberg app, check Bluetooth range, and try again.
error.otp_refill_failed: Refill failed or is incomplete. Read the pool before retrying; the lock may have accepted some codes.
error.invalid_otp_count: Enter a whole number from 1 to 10.

get_remote_otps.name: Read remote OTP pool (experimental)
get_remote_otps.description: Read existing codes via Home Assistant Bluetooth. Does not generate, reserve, or consume codes. Codes appear in the action response.

config_entry_id.name: Lock
config_entry_id.description: The Atomberg integration instance to query.

refill_otps.name: Refill OTP pool (experimental)
refill_otps.description: Write random six-digit credentials to the lock and verify by reading them back. Does not synchronize the Atomberg app. One-time use requires hardware validation. Do not automatically retry on failure.

config_entry_id.name: Lock
config_entry_id.description: The Atomberg integration instance to refill.

count.name: Number of codes
count.description: Start with one code for hardware validation. The firmware pool capacity is unknown.
